text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer won the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Yet, she felt regret over not being able 
to run true to herself all the way to the 
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen ran with all her heart for 
the Mejiro family. Mejiro Palmer, on the 
other hand, ran for her own freedom, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is this really something to be proud of? 
Isn't it just purely selfish? She couldn't 
help but question herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the spring Grand Prix, 
the Takarazuka Kinen. In a festival-like 
race that fires up fans and runners alike, 
can Mejiro Palmer rediscover her true 
self?
